214: // FindDefaultCredentialsWithParams searches for "Application Default Credentials".
215: //

217: // preferring the first location found:

219: //  1. A JSON file whose path is specified by the
220: //     GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable.
221: //     For workload identity federation, refer to
222: //     https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/how-to#using-workload-identity-federation on
223: //     how to generate the JSON configuration file for on-prem/non-Google cloud
224: //     platforms.
225: //  2. A JSON file in a location known to the gcloud command-line tool.
226: //     On Windows, this is %APPDATA%/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json.
227: //     On other systems, $HOME/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json.
228: //  3. On Google Compute Engine, Google App Engine standard second generation runtimes
229: //     (>= Go 1.11), and Google App Engine flexible environment, it fetches
230: //     credentials from the metadata server.
231: func FindDefaultCredentialsWithParams(ctx context.Context, params CredentialsParams) (*Credentials, error) {
232: 	// Make defensive copy of the slices in params.
233: 	params = params.deepCopy()
234: 
235: 	// First, try the environment variable.
236: 	const envVar = "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"
237: 	if filename := os.Getenv(envVar); filename != "" {
238: 		creds, err := readCredentialsFile(ctx, filename, params)
239: 		if err != nil {
240: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("google: error getting credentials using %v environment variable: %v", envVar, err)
241: 		}
242: 		return creds, nil
243: 	}
244: 
245: 	// Second, try a well-known file.
246: 	filename := wellKnownFile()
247: 	if b, err := os.ReadFile(filename); err == nil {
248: 		return CredentialsFromJSONWithParams(ctx, b, params)
249: 	}
250: 
251: 	// Third, if we're on Google Compute Engine, an App Engine standard second generation runtime,
252: 	// or App Engine flexible, use the metadata server.
253: 	if metadata.OnGCE() {
254: 		id, _ := metadata.ProjectID()
255: 		universeDomainProvider := func() (string, error) {
256: 			universeDomain, err := metadata.Get("universe/universe_domain")
257: 			if err != nil {
258: 				if _, ok := err.(metadata.NotDefinedError); ok {
259: 					// http.StatusNotFound (404)
260: 					return defaultUniverseDomain, nil
261: 				} else {
262: 					return "", err
263: 				}
264: 			}
265: 			return universeDomain, nil
266: 		}
267: 		return &Credentials{
268: 			ProjectID:              id,
269: 			TokenSource:            computeTokenSource("", params.EarlyTokenRefresh, params.Scopes...),
270: 			UniverseDomainProvider: universeDomainProvider,
271: 			universeDomain:         params.UniverseDomain,
272: 		}, nil
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	// None are found; return helpful error.
276: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("google: could not find default credentials. See %v for more information", adcSetupURL)
277: }

	params = params.deepCopy()

		return CredentialsFromJSONWithParams(ctx, b, params)

	// or App Engine flexible, use the metadata server.
	if metadata.OnGCE() {
		id, _ := metadata.ProjectID()
		universeDomainProvider := func() (string, error) {
			universeDomain, err := metadata.Get("universe/universe_domain")
			if err != nil {

					return defaultUniverseDomain, nil

			return universeDomain, nil

			ProjectID:              id,
			TokenSource:            computeTokenSource("", params.EarlyTokenRefresh, params.Scopes...),

Using workload identity federation, your application can access Google Cloud

provider that supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0.
Traditionally, applications running outside Google Cloud have used service

you can allow your workload to impersonate a service account.

Follow the detailed instructions on how to configure Workload Identity Federation
in various platforms:

Amazon Web Services (AWS): https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation-with-other-clouds#aws
Microsoft Azure: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation-with-other-clouds#azure
OIDC identity provider: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation-with-other-providers#oidc
SAML 2.0 identity provider: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/workload-identity-federation-with-other-providers#saml

(URL-sourced credentials), from a local executable (executable-sourced
credentials), or from a user defined function that returns an OIDC or SAML token.

return the OIDC/SAML token. The response can be in plain text or JSON.

// NewTokenSource Returns an external account TokenSource using the provided external account config.
func NewTokenSource(ctx context.Context, conf Config) (oauth2.TokenSource, error) {
	if conf.Audience == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth2/google/externalaccount: Audience must be set")
	}
	if conf.SubjectTokenType == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth2/google/externalaccount: Subject token type must be set")
	}
	if conf.WorkforcePoolUserProject != "" {
		valid := validateWorkforceAudience(conf.Audience)
		if !valid {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth2/google/externalaccount: Workforce pool user project should not be set for non-workforce pool credentials")
		}
	}
	count := 0
	if conf.CredentialSource != nil {
		count++
	}
	if conf.SubjectTokenSupplier != nil {
		count++
	}
	if conf.AwsSecurityCredentialsSupplier != nil {
		count++
	}
	if count == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth2/google/externalaccount: One of CredentialSource, SubjectTokenSupplier, or AwsSecurityCredentialsSupplier must be set")
	}
	if count > 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth2/google/externalaccount: Only one of CredentialSource, SubjectTokenSupplier, or AwsSecurityCredentialsSupplier must be set")
	}
	return conf.tokenSource(ctx, "https")
}
